description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text, with full UTF-8 support and a file-to-data-URL converter.

faqs.a: Yes. Encoding uses a UTF-8 path (TextEncoder), so emoji and non-English text round-trip correctly — plain btoa alone would corrupt them.
